# Kotlin top-levels of every kind: arrays (of integers for Klaxon's
# parseArray), maps (of objects for kotlinx), primitives, enums and unions.
input schema Ints {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "integer"}}
input schema Names {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}}
input schema Table {"type": "object", "additionalProperties": {"type": "number"}}
input schema Bag {"type": "object", "additionalProperties": {"type": "object", "additionalProperties": {}}}
input schema Count {"type": "integer"}
input schema Ratio {"type": "number"}
input schema Title {"type": "string"}
input schema Flag {"type": "boolean"}
input schema When {"type": "string", "format": "date-time"}
input schema Color {"enum": ["red", "green", "light blue"]}
input schema Either {"anyOf": [{"type": "integer"}, {"type": "string"}, {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "number"}}, {"type": "null"}]}
input schema Point {"type": "object", "properties": {"x": {"type": "number"}}, "required": ["x"]}
pipeline {"lang": "kotlin"}

render kotlin {}
render kotlin {"rendererOptions": {"framework": "klaxon"}}
